misreadings.quote: He says he feels well while failing the simplest familiar movement.
misreadings.evidence: Apart from a really excessive drowsiness after the long sleep, Gregor, in fact, felt quite well and even had a really strong appetite.
misreadings.explanation: That he feels well is narrator report of his inner state, and Gregor says nothing aloud to anyone, so 'says' misattributes it as speech.

result.note: Both versions follow the text closely (boss, parents' debt, five or six years, insurance doctor); the only slip found is the loose 'He says he feels well' in the prose rendering.
